Container.Name: lorestudio-backend
Container.Overview: LoreStudio API, for running LoreStudio as two containers (with lorestudio-frontend) on a custom 'lorestudio' network. Most people want the all-in-one 'lorestudio' template instead. See https://github.com/brentonmallen1/LoreStudio/blob/main/docs/unraid.md

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: REQUIRED - the password for the 'admin' account, created on first start.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: REQUIRED - signs sign-in tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database, uploads, snapshots and backups. Must be writable by uid 1000.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Optional - the Ollama server for AI features.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for dates and automatic work.
